values.subject: [Bali 2026] AXA family quote TI-Q-20260602
values.body_text: Quote TI-Q-20260602 covers Chen Yu and Wang Meilin for the full 22-day Indonesia trip, with Liu Fang joining on 2026-06-22. Base premium is CNY 1,860. The pregnancy-complication rider for gestational weeks 20-28 adds CNY 2,180, for a total of CNY 4,040. The quote expires 2026-06-05T09:55:00+08:00. The rider covers emergency complications only and excludes elective procedures and routine prenatal care abroad.
